sentences.en: So my name is Amy Webb, and a few years ago I found myself at the end of yet another fantastic relationship that came burning down in a spectacular fashion.
sentences.zh: 你说我 到底怎么了？真不懂 为什么每次都这样我就去问 身边的人看他们 怎么想我找到 姥姥她总有 很多忠告

sentences.en: And I thought, what's wrong with me? I don't understand why this keeps happening.
sentences.zh: 她总有 很多忠告她说 “别太挑剔了"“你得 多跟人谈谈"“还有 最重要的是“

sentences.en: So I asked everybody in my life what they thought.
sentences.zh: “还有 最重要的是““顺其自然 缘分始终会来的“

sentences.en: I turned to my grandmother, who always had plenty of advice, and she said, "Stop being so picky.
sentences.zh: “顺其自然 缘分始终会来的“而实际上我这个人 总要找依据这点相信你 很快会发现

sentences.en: You've got to date around. And most importantly, true love will find you when you least expect it."
sentences.zh: 这点相信你 很快会发现我总是沉浸在 数字当中长期和公式 图表打交道同时 我的家庭 非常和睦

sentences.en: Now as it turns out, I'm somebody who thinks a lot about data, as you'll soon find.
sentences.zh: 同时 我的家庭 非常和睦我和姐姐 关系特别好所以 从小我就想长大以后 要有一个温暖的大家庭

sentences.en: I am constantly swimming in numbers, formulas and charts.
sentences.zh: 长大以后 要有一个温暖的大家庭所以这次分手 很伤心我当时30岁想着 起码要和下一任

sentences.en: I also have a very tight-knit family, and I'm very, very close with my sister, and as a result, I wanted to have the same type of family when I grew up.
sentences.zh: 想着 起码要和下一任交往6个月才能真正 确定关系然后再考虑 搬一起住之后再过段时间 才考虑订婚

sentences.en: So I'm at the end of this bad breakup, I'm 30 years old, I figure I'm probably going to have to date somebody for about six months before I'm ready to get monogamous and before we can sort of cohabitate, and we have to do that for a while before we can get engaged.
sentences.zh: 之后再过段时间 才考虑订婚所以 如果想在35岁之前 要孩子就意味着我必须提前5年为结婚做准备很明显 那行不通如果换个思路 “顺其自然”等缘分那么 我要面临的变数 是运气

sentences.en: And if I want to start having children by the time I'm 35, that meant that I would have had to have been on my way to marriage five years ago.
sentences.zh: 那么 我要面临的变数 是运气那么 我要面临的变数 是运气简单来说 我想探个究竟 看看随缘偶遇真命天子 概率有多高

sentences.en: So that wasn't going to work. If my strategy was to least-expect my way into true love, then the variable that I had to deal with was serendipity.
sentences.zh: 随缘偶遇真命天子 概率有多高当时我呢 住在费城这是个大城市 所以我判断地方越大 机会越大

sentences.en: In short, I was trying to figure out what's the probability of my finding Mr. Right?
sentences.zh: 地方越大 机会越大接着我又开始 算数了费城人口：总共150万

sentences.en: Well, at the time I was living in the city of Philadelphia, and it's a big city, and I figured, in this entire place, there are lots of possibilities.
sentences.zh: 费城人口：总共150万估计 一半是男性有效人数 下降到75万我的目标是 30到36岁之间的男性

sentences.en: So again, I started doing some math. Population of Philadelphia: it has 1.5 million people.
sentences.zh: 我的目标是 30到36岁之间的男性他们 占这部分人口的4%算起来 可能剩下3万人

sentences.en: I figure about half of that are men, so that takes the number down to 750,000.
sentences.zh: 算起来 可能剩下3万人我要找 犹太人因为我本身也是 这点很重要

sentences.en: I'm looking for a guy between the ages of 30 and 36, which was only four percent of the population, so now I'm dealing with the possibility of 30,000 men.
sentences.zh: 因为我本身也是 这点很重要他们只占 这部分人口的2.3%然后 估计10个人当中 有1个我喜欢然后 估计10个人当中 有1个我喜欢还有 我和爱打高尔夫的 完全合不来

sentences.en: I was looking for somebody who was Jewish, because I am and that was important to me.
sentences.zh: 还有 我和爱打高尔夫的 完全合不来还有 我和爱打高尔夫的 完全合不来也就是说 对我而言

sentences.en: That's only 2.3 percent of the population.
sentences.zh: 也就是说 对我而言

sentences.en: I figure I'm attracted to maybe one out of 10 of those men, and there was no way I was going to deal with somebody who was an avid golfer.
sentences.zh: 也就是说 对我而言费城总共有35位男士 适宜约会在整个费城！与此同时 我们犹太大家族

sentences.en: So that basically meant there were 35 men for me that I could possibly date in the entire city of Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 与此同时 我们犹太大家族其他成员 全部都结了婚而且还生了 很多很多孩子所以我总有 巨大的压力和紧迫感要尽快解决 人生大事

sentences.en: In the meantime, my very large Jewish family was already all married and well on their way to having lots and lots of children, and I felt like I was under tremendous peer pressure to get my life going already.
sentences.zh: 要尽快解决 人生大事这时候 我有两个办法我发现一是 可以听姥姥的话尝试“顺其自然” 碰上那一位尝试“顺其自然” 碰上那一位在费城茫茫 150万人海中

sentences.en: So I have two possible strategies at this point I'm sort of figuring out.
sentences.zh: 在费城茫茫 150万人海中偶遇那35位男士 其中的一位

sentences.en: One, I can take my grandmother's advice and sort of least-expect my way into maybe bumping into the one out of 35 possible men in the entire 1.5-million-person city of Philadelphia,
sentences.zh: 偶遇那35位男士 其中的一位又或者 我可以试试婚恋网其实我挺喜欢 这个概念因为我们可以 用运算规则推算结果所谓运算规则 其实很简单当我们遇到问题 只要收集数据放到系统里面 就能找到解决办法

sentences.en: or I could try online dating. Now, I like the idea of online dating, because it's predicated on an algorithm, and that's really just a simple way of saying I've got a problem, I'm going to use some data, run it through a system and get to a solution.
sentences.zh: 放到系统里面 就能找到解决办法放到系统里面 就能找到解决办法婚恋网 现在已经成为大家互相认识的 第二大途径不过 网站的运算规则在几千年前 就可以找到例如犹太族 从很早以前就有媒人

sentences.en: So online dating is the second most popular way that people now meet each other, but as it turns out, algorithms have been around for thousands of years in almost every culture.
sentences.zh: 例如犹太族 从很早以前就有媒人例如犹太族 从很早以前就有媒人虽然他们没有 列出公式但在脑子里 一定琢磨过这些问题比如 女孩会喜欢男孩吗？两家人能处得来吗？

sentences.en: In fact, in Judaism, there were matchmakers a long time ago, and though they didn't have an explicit algorithm per se, they definitely were running through formulas in their heads, like, is the girl going to like the boy?
sentences.zh: 两家人能处得来吗？拉比(犹太教教师或法学导师)会怎么说？他们会不会马上生孩子？媒人们会 先想好这些问题再把两个人凑到一起 就完事了而我呢 我想

sentences.en: Are the families going to get along? What's the rabbi going to say?
sentences.zh: 而我呢 我想能不能通过数据和公式

sentences.en: Are they going to start having children right away?
sentences.zh: 能不能通过数据和公式帮我找到白马王子？我决定注册

sentences.en: The matchmaker would sort of think through all of this, put two people together, and that would be the end of it.
sentences.zh: 我决定注册这里还有一个小插曲我开设了几个婚恋网帐户

sentences.en: So in my case, I thought, well, will data and an algorithm lead me to my Prince Charming?
sentences.zh: 我开设了几个婚恋网帐户碰巧那段时间特别 特别忙不过那还不是 最大的问题最大的 问题是

sentences.en: So I decided to sign on. Now, there was one small catch.
sentences.zh: 最大的 问题是我讨厌填 问答表尤其不喜欢 时尚杂志小编爱问的题目

sentences.en: As I'm signing on to the various dating websites, as it happens, I was really, really busy.
sentences.zh: 尤其不喜欢 时尚杂志小编爱问的题目尤其不喜欢 时尚杂志小编爱问的题目所以我直接把简历 复制粘贴上去

sentences.en: But that actually wasn't the biggest problem.
sentences.zh: 所以我直接把简历 复制粘贴上去（笑声）

sentences.en: The biggest problem is that I hate filling out questionnaires of any kind, and I certainly don't like questionnaires that are like Cosmo quizzes.
sentences.zh: （笑声）上面 描述部分我说我是 获奖记者

sentences.en: So I just copied and pasted from my résumé.
sentences.zh: 我说我是 获奖记者和未来思考者

sentences.en: (Laughter) So in the descriptive part up top, I said that I was an award-winning journalist and a future thinker.
sentences.zh: 和未来思考者让我描述兴趣爱好和理想人选我填了 赚钱和日语流利还写了很多关于 网页编码的内容这一步 走得确实不太优雅

sentences.en: When I was asked about fun activities and my ideal date, I said monetization and fluency in Japanese.
sentences.zh: 这一步 走得确实不太优雅这一步 走得确实不太优雅最根本的问题是还是有很多男士 和我约会

sentences.en: I talked a lot about JavaScript. (Laughter) So obviously this was not the best way to put my most sexy foot forward.
sentences.zh: 还是有很多男士 和我约会配对公式 为我找到一大批男士他们不断约我－－可结果却特别糟糕

sentences.en: But the real failure was that there were plenty of men for me to date.
sentences.zh: 可结果却特别糟糕其中有一位 叫史蒂夫的技术男配对公式 发现我们都对小玩意着迷

sentences.en: These algorithms had a sea full of men that wanted to take me out on lots of dates -- what turned out to be truly awful dates.
sentences.zh: 配对公式 发现我们都对小玩意着迷配对公式 发现我们都对小玩意着迷我们是数学迷 数据迷 还是80年代歌迷我同意见他

sentences.en: There was this guy Steve, the I.T. guy. The algorithm matched us up because we share a love of gadgets, we share a love of math and data and '80s music, and so I agreed to go out with him.
sentences.zh: 我同意见他然后这位技术男 带我到费城一家 特别高消费的西餐厅费城一家 特别高消费的西餐厅刚到 我们就发现谈得 不太有意思但他 点了很多吃的

sentences.en: So Steve the I.T. guy invited me out to one of Philadelphia's white-table-cloth, extremely expensive restaurants.
sentences.zh: 但他 点了很多吃的他餐牌都 不用看就点了几份 开胃菜几份主食 还帮我点了

sentences.en: And we went in, and right off the bat, our conversation really wasn't taking flight, but he was ordering a lot of food.
sentences.zh: 几份主食 还帮我点了忽然间 桌上堆满了大盘小盘吃的还有 很多很多瓶酒在我们 谈得差不多

sentences.en: In fact, he didn't even bother looking at the menu.
sentences.zh: 在我们 谈得差不多晚餐也 接近尾声的时候

sentences.en: He was ordering multiple appetizers, multiple entrées, for me as well, and suddenly there are piles and piles of food on our table, also lots and lots of bottles of wine.
sentences.zh: 晚餐也 接近尾声的时候我确信和技术男 并非天生一对但再见 还可以是朋友他去趟 洗手间帐单也来了

sentences.en: So we're nearing the end of our conversation and the end of dinner, and I've decided Steve the I.T. guy and I are really just not meant for each other, but we'll part ways as friends, when he gets up to go to the bathroom,
sentences.zh: 帐单也来了看 我是现代女性平分帐单完全没问题但 技术男却没回来（倒吸气）

sentences.en: and in the meantime, the bill comes to our table.
sentences.zh: 但 技术男却没回来（倒吸气）而那是我 整整一个月的房租

sentences.en: And listen, I'm a modern woman. I am totally down with splitting the bill.
sentences.zh: 而那是我 整整一个月的房租不用说 我那天晚上很不好受

sentences.en: But then Steve the I.T. guy didn't come back.
sentences.zh: 跑回家之后 我打电话找妈妈 找姐姐

sentences.en: (Gasping) And that was my entire month's rent.
sentences.zh: 跑回家之后 我打电话找妈妈 找姐姐每一次经历这些 糟糕至极的约会之后我都会 打给她们

sentences.en: (Audience gasps) So needless to say, I was not having a good night.
sentences.zh: 我都会 打给她们我披露 每一个细节之后 她们对我说

sentences.en: So I run home, I call my mother, I call my sister, and as I do, at the end of each one of these terrible, terrible dates, I regale them with the details.
sentences.zh: 之后 她们对我说“别抱怨了”（笑声）“你就是太挑”我说 好吧 那以后我只去 有无线网络的地方约会要带上 手提电脑

sentences.en: And they say to me, "Stop complaining." (Laughter) "You're just being too picky."
sentences.zh: 要带上 手提电脑把它 塞到袋子里然后做一个 邮件模版把收集到的信息 填进去

sentences.en: So I said, fine, from here on out I'm only going on dates where I know there's Wi-Fi, and I'm bringing my laptop.
sentences.zh: 一边约会 一边填用客观事实 向大家证实这些约会 究竟有多糟糕 （笑声）

sentences.en: I'm going to shove it into my bag, I'm going to have this email template, and I'm going to fill it out and collect information on all these different data points during the date to prove to everybody that empirically, these dates really are terrible.
sentences.zh: 这些约会 究竟有多糟糕 （笑声）我开始 记录那些无聊又尴尬的 性暗示语言不适当的用词还有对方 逼我与他击掌的次数（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) So I started tracking things like really stupid, awkward, sexual remarks; bad vocabulary; the number of times a man forced me to high-five him.
sentences.zh: （笑声）然后我开始 统计这些数据并且找到 一些关联我发现不知为什么 喝苏格兰威士忌的男性

sentences.en: (Laughter) So I started to crunch some numbers, and that allowed me to make some correlations.
sentences.zh: 不知为什么 喝苏格兰威士忌的男性立马联想到 性怪癖（笑声）当然 不是说

sentences.en: So as it turns out, for some reason, men who drink Scotch reference kinky sex immediately.
sentences.zh: 当然 不是说他们不好只是 不适合我同样 把我们凑到一起的 配对公式也不差

sentences.en: (Laughter) Well, it turns out that these probably weren't bad guys.
sentences.zh: 也不差它们按预先设计好的 正常运行它们按预先设计好的 正常运行用提取到的 用户信息

sentences.en: There were just bad for me. And as it happens, the algorithms that were setting us up, they weren't bad either.
sentences.zh: 用提取到的 用户信息比如 我的简历再和其他人的信息 配对可见 真正的问题是

sentences.en: These algorithms were doing exactly what they were designed to do, which was to take our user-generated information, in my case, my résumé, and match it up with other people's information.
sentences.zh: 可见 真正的问题是虽然公式会按部就班我们却没有当我们面对 空白栏填写 个人信息的地方没有多少人可以赤裸裸地 描述完全真实的自己

sentences.en: See, the real problem here is that, while the algorithms work just fine, you and I don't, when confronted with blank windows where we're supposed to input our information online.
sentences.zh: 可以赤裸裸地 描述完全真实的自己另一个问题是 网站总爱问你喜欢猫还是喜欢狗？爱看惊悚片还是爱情片？之类的问题

sentences.en: Very few of us have the ability to be totally and brutally honest with ourselves.
sentences.zh: 爱看惊悚片还是爱情片？之类的问题我又不是来找笔友我在找丈夫 对吧？

sentences.en: The other problem is that these websites are asking us questions like, are you a dog person or a cat person?
sentences.zh: 我在找丈夫 对吧？而这些数据 比较肤浅所以 我有个新计划

sentences.en: Do you like horror films or romance films?
sentences.zh: 所以 我有个新计划继续上 婚恋网但只把它们当作 资料库

sentences.en: I'm not looking for a pen pal. I'm looking for a husband. Right?
sentences.zh: 但只把它们当作 资料库而不是继续 被动地等公式配对

sentences.en: So there's a certain amount of superficiality in that data.
sentences.zh: 而不是继续 被动地等公式配对我要把整个系统反过来 重新定义

sentences.en: So I said fine, I've got a new plan. I'm going to keep using these online dating sites, but I'm going to treat them as databases, and rather than waiting for an algorithm to set me up, I think I'm going to try reverse-engineering this entire system.
sentences.zh: 我要把整个系统反过来 重新定义既然公式配对 用的是肤浅信息既然公式配对 用的是肤浅信息我决定 自己问问题我要找的 另一半需要具备 哪些条件呢？

sentences.en: So knowing that there was superficial data that was being used to match me up with other people, I decided instead to ask my own questions.
sentences.zh: 需要具备 哪些条件呢？我开始写 不停地写到最后 我积攒了72个数据点到最后 我积攒了72个数据点

sentences.en: What was every single possible thing that I could think of that I was looking for in a mate?
sentences.zh: 到最后 我积攒了72个数据点我想找 犹太人找一个与我有 共同文化背景和观点的人

sentences.en: So I started writing and writing and writing, and at the end, I had amassed 72 different data points.
sentences.zh: 找一个与我有 共同文化背景和观点的人找一个与我有 共同文化背景和观点的人但他又不会 强迫我每周五六去 犹太集会我想找一个 勤奋的人

sentences.en: I wanted somebody was Jew-ish, so I was looking for somebody who had the same background and thoughts on our culture, but wasn't going to force me to go to shul every Friday and Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我想找一个 勤奋的人因为我觉得 工作特别重要但不能 工作狂对我来说 我的兴趣无非是我的 一些新项目我还想找一个 打算生两个小孩

sentences.en: I wanted somebody who worked hard, because work for me is extremely important, but not too hard.
sentences.zh: 我还想找一个 打算生两个小孩而且在育儿方面和我 观点一致的人也就是说 他完全不介意

sentences.en: For me, the hobbies that I have are really just new work projects that I've launched.
sentences.zh: 也就是说 他完全不介意要孩子三岁学钢琴可能还外加一些 电脑课

sentences.en: I also wanted somebody who not only wanted two children, but was going to have the same attitude toward parenting that I do, so somebody who was going to be totally okay with forcing our child to start taking piano lessons at age three,
sentences.zh: 可能还外加一些 电脑课如果 条件允许的话除此之外 我还想找一个愿意 远足异乡的人一起去 约旦的彼得拉还有 我希望他

sentences.en: and also maybe computer science classes if we could wrangle it.
sentences.zh: 还有 我希望他比我重20磅 不论时间也不论我当时 体重是多少（笑声）

sentences.en: So things like that, but I also wanted somebody who would go to far-flung, exotic places, like Petra, Jordan.
sentences.zh: （笑声）有了这 72个数据点说实话 还真不少了

sentences.en: I also wanted somebody who would weigh 20 pounds more than me at all times, regardless of what I weighed.
sentences.zh: 说实话 还真不少了接下来着 我整理出优先次序分两层 排列这些数据点

sentences.en: (Laughter) So I now have these 72 different data points, which, to be fair, is a lot.
sentences.zh: 分两层 排列这些数据点然后从100排到91？

sentences.en: So what I did was, I went through and I prioritized that list.
sentences.zh: 排到91？写的有 我希望找一个 很聪明的人

sentences.en: I broke it into a top tier and a second tier of points, and I ranked everything starting at 100 and going all the way down to 91, and listing things like I was looking for somebody who was really smart,
sentences.zh: 写的有 我希望找一个 很聪明的人一个可以给我带来 挑战和刺激的人然后在第二层放上 另外一组数据点这些对我 同样重要但不是 必不可少列表完毕 之后

sentences.en: who would challenge and stimulate me, and balancing that with a second tier and a second set of points.
sentences.zh: 列表完毕 之后我开始 建立计分系统我想尝试 借助数学计算出

sentences.en: These things were also important to me but not necessarily deal-breakers.
sentences.zh: 我想尝试 借助数学计算出我想尝试 借助数学计算出我和网站人选 是否匹配

sentences.en: (Laughter) So once I had all this done, I then built a scoring system, because what I wanted to do was to sort of mathematically calculate whether or not I thought the guy that I found online
sentences.zh: 我和网站人选 是否匹配我和网站人选 是否匹配我想 对方至少要达到700分才给他 发电子邮件或者 回信达到900分 才答应约会我不会轻易 投入感情

sentences.en: would be a match with me. I figured there would be a minimum of 700 points before I would agree to email somebody or respond to an email message.
sentences.zh: 我不会轻易 投入感情除非对方 超过1500分才可以考虑这个方法 还挺有效的我回到 婚恋网

sentences.en: For 900 points, I'd agree to go out on a date, and I wouldn't even consider any kind of relationship before somebody had crossed the 1,500 point threshold.
sentences.zh: 我回到 婚恋网发现了 Jewishdoc57他出奇地帅 而且谈吐出众曾经登上 富士山

sentences.en: Well, as it turns out, this worked pretty well.
sentences.zh: 曾经登上 富士山徒步长城而且他喜欢旅行 只要没有游船就好

sentences.en: So I go back online now. I found Jewishdoc57 who's incredibly good-looking, incredibly well-spoken, he had hiked Mt. Fuji, he had walked along the Great Wall.
sentences.zh: 而且他喜欢旅行 只要没有游船就好我想 我成功了！编码已被破解我终于发现了 犹太白马王子正如 家人所愿

sentences.en: He likes to travel as long as it doesn't involve a cruise ship.
sentences.zh: 正如 家人所愿问题 只有一个

sentences.en: And I thought, I've done it! I've cracked the code.
sentences.zh: 问题 只有一个他 并不喜欢我看来有一个变数 我还没考虑

sentences.en: I have just found the Jewish Prince Charming of my family's dreams.
sentences.zh: 看来有一个变数 我还没考虑那就是 竞争对手社交网站 都有哪些 其他的女性？

sentences.en: There was only one problem: He didn't like me back.
sentences.zh: 社交网站 都有哪些 其他的女性？我发现了 SmileyGirl1978

sentences.en: And I guess the one variable that I haven't considered is the competition.
sentences.zh: 我发现了 SmileyGirl1978她说她是 "快乐、活泼、有趣的女孩"她填写的职业是 教师

sentences.en: Who are all of the other women on these dating sites?
sentences.zh: 她说她 "很傻 很友善““常常”爱逗大家笑

sentences.en: I found SmileyGirl1978. She said she was a "Fun girl who is Happy and Outgoing."
sentences.zh: “常常”爱逗大家笑就在那一刻 在点击完一个又一个类似的个人档案之后我知道还需要 市场调研

sentences.en: She listed her job as "teacher." She said she is "silly, nice and friendly."
sentences.zh: 我知道还需要 市场调研接着我建立了 10个虚拟的 男士档案

sentences.en: She likes to make people laugh "alot." At this moment I knew, clicking profile after profile that looked like this, that I needed to do some market research.
sentences.zh: 接着我建立了 10个虚拟的 男士档案在人都 走光之前（笑声）-我想请大家 谅解我的初衷仅仅是 收集数据

sentences.en: So I created 10 fake male profiles. Now, before I lose all of you -- (Laughter) -- understand that I did this strictly to gather data
sentences.zh: 仅仅是 收集数据去了解系统内的 其他人我并没有 借此进行任何不道德的交流确实只是 收集数据还不是 所有人的数据仅限女性 那些我的理想伴侣 可能会喜欢的女性（笑声）

sentences.en: about everybody else in the system. I didn't carry on crazy Catfish-style relationships with anybody.
sentences.zh: 我的理想伴侣 可能会喜欢的女性（笑声）我的理想伴侣 可能会喜欢的女性（笑声）我把虚拟男士 放出来之后

sentences.en: I really was just scraping their data. But I didn't want everybody's data.
sentences.zh: 我把虚拟男士 放出来之后还遵守了 一些规矩首先我没有 主动联系女性

sentences.en: I only wanted data on the women who were going to be attracted to the type of man that I really, really wanted to marry.
sentences.zh: 首先我没有 主动联系女性只等着看 能吸引到谁主要关注点 有两方面

sentences.en: When I released these men into the wild, I did follow some rules.
sentences.zh: 主要关注点 有两方面首先是 定性数据比如 幽默感 语调声音 沟通方式

sentences.en: So I didn't reach out to any woman first.
sentences.zh: 声音 沟通方式这些女性 的共通点是什么？

sentences.en: I just waited to see who these profiles were going to attract, and mainly what I was looking at was two different data sets.
sentences.zh: 这些女性 的共通点是什么？还有 定量数据比如 个人档案的平均长度两次通信之间 隔多久

sentences.en: So I was looking at qualitative data, so what was the humor, the tone, the voice, the communication style that these women shared in common?
sentences.zh: 两次通信之间 隔多久我想证明的是如果有机会 面对面交流我的竞争力不比SmileyGirl1978差

sentences.en: And also quantitative data, so what was the average length of their profile, how much time was spent between messages?
sentences.zh: 不比SmileyGirl1978差所以 我想知道怎么调整 网上档案才能最好地 呈现自己一个月 之后

sentences.en: What I was trying to get at here was that I figured, in person, I would be just as competitive as a SmileyGirl1978.
sentences.zh: 一个月 之后我收集了大量数据 足够再分析一回结果发现 内容很重要

sentences.en: I wanted to figure out how to maximize my own profile online.
sentences.zh: 结果发现 内容很重要聪明的人 往往写很多 — —3、4千

sentences.en: Well, one month later, I had a lot of data, and I was able to do another analysis.
sentences.zh: 3、4千甚至5千字 自我介绍也许真的 非常非常有意思但 很难匹敌

sentences.en: And as it turns out, content matters a lot.
sentences.zh: 但 很难匹敌最受欢迎男女精选的97个字

sentences.en: So smart people tend to write a lot -- 3,000, 4,000, 5,000 words about themselves, which may all be very, very interesting.
sentences.zh: 精选的97个字精选的97个字虽然我们不一定 感觉得到高手们的另外一个杀手锏

sentences.en: The challenge here, though, is that the popular men and women are sticking to 97 words on average that are written very, very well, even though it may not seem like it all the time.
sentences.zh: 高手们的另外一个杀手锏是不特定语言以我为例 你看"英国病人" 是我 最喜欢的电影但它不适合 放在个人档案里面

sentences.en: The other hallmark of the people who do this well is that they're using non-specific language.
sentences.zh: 但它不适合 放在个人档案里面因为这是一个 肤浅的数据点有人可能 会有不同意见并且 决定不和我约会

sentences.en: So in my case, "The English Patient" is my most favorite movie ever, but it doesn't work to use that in a profile, because that's a superficial data point, and somebody may disagree and decide they don't want to go out
sentences.zh: 并且 决定不和我约会仅仅因为他们不愿意 花三个小时看一场电影还有 积极正面的语言很重要看这些关键词里面是 最常用的词语最受欢迎女性 都在用比如 "有趣" “女孩” 还有 “爱”

sentences.en: because they didn't like sitting through the three-hour movie.
sentences.zh: 比如 "有趣" “女孩” 还有 “爱”后来 我意识到没必要写一个 低智商简介

sentences.en: Also, optimistic language matters a lot.
sentences.zh: 没必要写一个 低智商简介还记得吗 我说

sentences.en: So this is a word cloud highlighting the most popular words that were used by the most popular women, words like "fun" and "girl" and "love."
sentences.zh: 还记得吗 我说我能讲流利的日语 并且熟悉网页编码这些都 没问题重点是 怎么写 让自己显得更亲切

sentences.en: And what I realized was not that I had to dumb down my own profile.
sentences.zh: 重点是 怎么写 让自己显得更亲切让别人知道 怎么采取主动让别人知道 怎么采取主动

sentences.en: Remember, I'm somebody who said that I speak fluent Japanese and I know JavaScript and I was okay with that.
sentences.zh: 让别人知道 怎么采取主动除此之外 时机也非常重要当我们拿到别人的 手机号码

sentences.en: The difference is that it's about being more approachable and helping people understand the best way to reach out to you.
sentences.zh: 别人的 手机号码或者 聊天帐号碰巧凌晨2点还没睡也许不是 联系他们的好时机

sentences.en: And as it turns out, timing is also really, really important.
sentences.zh: 也许不是 联系他们的好时机最受欢迎的女性

sentences.en: Just because you have access to somebody's mobile phone number or their instant message account and it's 2 o'clock in the morning and you happen to be awake, doesn't mean that that's a good time to communicate with those people.
sentences.zh: 最受欢迎的女性一般会等 23小时再进行 下一次沟通这也是我们 约会时的常规这也是我们 约会时的常规最后 轮到照片了

sentences.en: The popular women on these online sites spend an average of 23 hours in between each communication.
sentences.zh: 最后 轮到照片了所有 受欢迎女性都会 露一些她们 看起来很棒

sentences.en: And that's what we would normally do in the usual process of courtship.
sentences.zh: 她们 看起来很棒形成 鲜明对比的是我当时 上传的照片

sentences.en: And finally -- there were the photos. All of the women who were popular showed some skin.
sentences.zh: 是我当时 上传的照片掌握了 这些信息之后我建立了一个 超级档案

sentences.en: They all looked really great, which turned out to be in sharp contrast to what I had uploaded.
sentences.zh: 我建立了一个 超级档案我 还是我只是 在这个生态系统当中 更优化的我事实证明 我做得很不错

sentences.en: (Laughter) Once I had all of this information, I was able to create a super profile, so it was still me, but it was me optimized now for this ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 事实证明 我做得很不错成了婚恋网 最受欢迎的人（笑声）（掌声）

sentences.en: And as it turns out, I did a really good job.
sentences.zh: （掌声）后来 特别特别多男人想和我约会

sentences.en: I was the most popular person online. (Laughter) (Applause) And as it turns out, lots and lots of men wanted to date me.
sentences.zh: 后来 特别特别多男人想和我约会我又打电话给 妈妈 姐姐 和姥姥告诉她们 这个好消息她们说 "真棒 ！““什么时候开始约会呀？"然后我说 "嗯 我不会跟任何一个约会的"因为 记得吧 要在计分系统

sentences.en: So I call my mom, I call my sister, I call my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 因为 记得吧 要在计分系统至少达到700分才行

sentences.en: I'm telling them about this fabulous news, and they say, "This is wonderful! How soon are you going out?"
sentences.zh: 至少达到700分才行这些男士们 都还不够她们就说 "什么？你还是太挑剔了"然后 没过多久

sentences.en: I said, "Actually, I'm not going to go out with anybody."
sentences.zh: 然后 没过多久我发现这个人 戴文宁（Thevenin）

sentences.en: Because remember, in my scoring system, they have to reach a minimum threshold of 700 points, and none of them have done that.
sentences.zh: 我发现这个人 戴文宁（Thevenin）他说他 接受犹太风俗还说他的工作是 猎捕北极小海豹

sentences.en: They said, "What? You're still being too damn picky."
sentences.zh: 还说他的工作是 猎捕北极小海豹我觉得 这个说法很有意思他详谈了很多 关于旅行的事

sentences.en: Well, not too long after that, I found this guy, Thevenin, and he said that he was culturally Jewish, he said that his job was an arctic baby seal hunter, which I thought was very clever.
sentences.zh: 他详谈了很多 关于旅行的事引用了各种 有趣的文化他外表和谈吐 都是我想要的当场就 拿下850分够约会了

sentences.en: He talked in detail about travel. He made a lot of really interesting cultural references.
sentences.zh: 够约会了三个星期之后 我们见面谈了足足 14小时

sentences.en: He looked and talked exactly like what I wanted, and immediately, he scored 850 points.
sentences.zh: 谈了足足 14小时从咖啡店 到餐厅到另一家咖啡厅 再到下一家餐厅那天晚上 他送我回家之后

sentences.en: It was enough for a date. Three weeks later, we met up in person for what turned out to be a 14-hour-long conversation that went from coffee shop to restaurant to another coffee shop to another restaurant, and when he dropped me back off at my house that night
sentences.zh: 那天晚上 他送我回家之后我重新评估[1,050分!]--看来我一直还 不够挑剔一年半之后我们去旅游 当然没有坐游船在约旦的 佩特拉

sentences.en: I re-scored him -- [1,050 points!] Thought, you know what, this entire time, I haven't been picky enough.
sentences.zh: 在约旦的 佩特拉他单膝下跪 求婚一年之后 我们结婚

sentences.en: Well, a year and a half after that, we were non-cruise ship traveling through Petra, Jordan, when he got down on his knee and proposed.
sentences.zh: 一年之后 我们结婚又过了一年半 我们的女儿佩特拉 出生了（掌声）

sentences.en: A year after that, we were married, and about a year and a half after that, our daughter, Petra, was born.
sentences.zh: （掌声）可以看到 我很享受这段精彩人生 不过（笑声）-问题是 这一切对你有什么意义？

sentences.en: Audience: Oh! (Applause) [What it means...]
sentences.zh: 问题是 这一切对你有什么意义？事实可以证明 爱有计算规则但不是我们 在网上看到的那些

sentences.en: Obviously, I'm having a fabulous life, so -- (Laughter) The question is, what does all of this mean for you?
sentences.zh: 但不是我们 在网上看到的那些而是 你自己写出来的所以无论你要 寻觅另一半

sentences.en: Well, as it turns out, there is an algorithm for love.
sentences.zh: 所以无论你要 寻觅另一半还是 找回激情又或者 要创业只需要 真真切切地 找出自己的框架

sentences.en: It's just not the ones that we're being presented with online.
sentences.zh: 只需要 真真切切地 找出自己的框架按自己的规则 进行发挥

sentences.en: In fact, it's something that you write yourself.
sentences.zh: 按自己的规则 进行发挥爱多挑剔 就多挑剔

sentences.en: So whether you're looking for a husband or a wife or you're trying to find your passion or you're trying to start a business, all you have to really do is figure out your own framework and play by your own rules, and feel free to be as picky as you want.
sentences.zh: 爱多挑剔 就多挑剔最后 在我的婚礼上我和姥姥 又谈了一回她说 "好吧 也许是我错了““看来 你确实做了”“一个 很棒很厉害的系统““可是 你的玛索球”

sentences.en: Well, on my wedding day, I had a conversation again with my grandmother, and she said, "All right, maybe I was wrong.
sentences.zh: “可是 你的玛索球”“该松软些 不能太硬了”这个意见 我赞成（掌声）

sentences.en: It looks like you did come up with a really, really great system.
sentences.zh: （掌声）

sentences.en: Now, your matzah balls ... They should be fluffy, not hard."
sentences.zh: （掌声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I'll take her advice on that.
sentences.zh: 我会接受她的建议的

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
